Method of Attack: Disguised as a fake Flash Player update site that automatically initiates a download
Installs a CPU miner that uses all available processing power
Creates a scheduled task to launch the miner executable on user login
Impacted Systems: Windows computers (implied by .exe and Task Scheduler usage)
Attack Vector: Drive-by download from fake Flash Player update scam website
Indicators of Compromise: High CPU usage due to CPU miner
